description: This file contains a class 'Coupons' with static methods implementing various financial functions related to bond coupons, such as calculating coupon days, coupon periods, next/previous coupon dates, and number of coupons. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine.

classes.name: Coupons
classes.description: A class providing static methods for various bond coupon calculations such as coupon days, periods, and dates, supporting different day count conventions.

methods.name: COUPDAYBS
methods.description: Calculates the number of days from the beginning of the coupon period to the settlement date.

methods.name: COUPDAYS
methods.description: Returns the number of days in the coupon period containing the settlement date.

methods.name: COUPDAYSNC
methods.description: Returns the number of days from the settlement date to the next coupon date.

methods.name: COUPNCD
methods.description: Returns the next coupon date after the settlement date.

methods.name: COUPNUM
methods.description: Returns the number of coupons payable between settlement and maturity dates.

methods.name: COUPPCD
methods.description: Returns the previous coupon date before the settlement date.
